# Group Run — Companion AI Platform

> Documentation for the Group Run multi-agent AI platform.

Group Run is a multi-agent AI platform powered by LangGraph and DeepAgents.
Backend: FastAPI + LangGraph on GCP Cloud Run. Frontend: React + Vite on Firebase Hosting.
Agents follow a supervisor-router pattern defined in teams.yaml.
MCP tools are loaded at runtime from mcp.json.
